events.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
events.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

events.summary: Around the New Phyrexian Invasion Corondor falls under Geyadrone Dihada's control again.
events.quote: the island fell back under the control of Geyadrone Dihada

relations.quote: He trapped them and forced them to battle until they were weak enough to be killed individually
three Defenders - Jared Carthalion , Kristina of the Woods , and Sandruu , who defended the land from the Conquerors
